# Audio - Spring AI and Ollama API

This example demonstrates how to use
[Spring AI](https://spring.io/projects/spring-ai) to synthesise speech from text
and to transcribe speech back into text using
[OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/docs/overview).

This example connects to OpenAI’s ChatGPT, hosted on OpenAI. An API
key—available from [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/)—is required.

---

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

- [OpenAI API Key](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)

## Run the example

1. OpenAI API Key

   If you have not already done so, please create an API key from
   [OpenAI API Key](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).

   For security purposes and to prevent exposing the API key in documentation,
   the following commands assume the key is saved in the
   `.chatgpt/openai-api.yml` file within the user’s home directory.

   ```yaml
   spring:
     ai:
       openai:
         api-key: sk-proj-XXXXX
   ```

2. Build the application

   This step assumes that a valid OpenAI API Key is available at
   `~/.chatgpt/openai-api.yml`. See Step 1 for more information about how to do
   this.

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean verify
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the application was created.

   ```shell
   tree --prune --sort=name -L 1 './target'
   ```

   The application Fat JAR file

   ```
   ./target
   ├── audio-springai-chatgpt-api-1.0.0.jar
   └── audio-springai-chatgpt-api-1.0.0.jar.original

   1 directory, 2 files
   ```

3. Run the program

   This step assumes that a valid OpenAI API Key is available at
   `~/.chatgpt/openai-api.yml`. See Step 1 for more information about how to do
   this.

   Run the example with the default prompt.

   ```shell
   # Enable native access for classpath code because Netty loads native
   # libraries, and recent JDKs warn unless unnamed-module native access is
   # explicitly allowed.
   java \
     --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED \
     -jar './target/audio-springai-chatgpt-api-1.0.0.jar'
   ```

   The program will synthesise speech from text and save it as an audio file,
   then use that file to transcribe the speech back into text.

   (*Optional*) Play the audio file to verify its quality

   - Use `ffplay`

     ```shell
     ffplay -nodisp -autoexit -loglevel quiet './target/audio/audio_20770427_113500.mp3'
     ```

   - Use `ffplay`

     ```shell
     afplay './target/audio/audio_20770427_113500.mp3'
     ```

   Run the example again with specific prompt.

   ```shell
   # Enable native access for classpath code because Netty loads native
   # libraries, and recent JDKs warn unless unnamed-module native access is
   # explicitly allowed.

     --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED \
     -jar './target/audio-springai-chatgpt-api-1.0.0.jar' \
     'Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?'
   ```
